home.not_installed: The game is not installed yet.
home.ready: {version} is downloaded and starts next time
home.no_release: No game release is published yet. Check again later.
home.unsupported: There is no game build for this system yet.
home.offline_none: Offline. Go online once to download the game.
notes.crashed: The game crashed (exit code {code}). See Game output.
notes.update_failed: The update failed, the installed game stays: {error}
notes.migrated: Profiles are gone: the launcher now has one game folder. The settings and saves of {profile} were kept.
notes.migrated_left: The folders of other profiles stay where they were: {folders}
log.none: The game has not been started yet.
mods.none: No mods installed. Browse the index or import a zip.
mods.has_code_hint: This mod carries Wasm code. It runs inside the game's sandbox, but only enable mods you trust.
mods.installed_disabled: Installed {id}. It stays disabled until you enable it.
mods.enable_warning: Mods are made by other people. Enable only mods from sources you trust.
mods.declares_code: Runs code: {file} (Wasm, in the game's sandbox)
mods.remove_body: {name} is deleted from the mods folder.
problem.duplicate: Another mod has the same id; the game will refuse to start.
problem.unknown_keys: mod.json has keys the game refuses: {keys}
problem.incompatible: Made for game {range}, the installed game is {game}.
browse.no_index: No mod index is set up.
browse.pick: Pick a mod from the list.
browse.install_note: Downloads are checked against the index's SHA-256. New mods start disabled.
browse.no_fitting_version: No version fits the installed game.
settings.offline_hint: No update checks and no downloads; the installed game and the cached index only.
settings.graphics_hint: Auto starts with Vulkan when a quick check says it works on this PC, otherwise with wgpu.
settings.window_hint: Such as 1280x720. Empty for the game's default.
settings.extra_hint: Split like a shell does; quotes group words.
settings.indexes_hint: An index is one JSON file (docs/mod-index.md). The first index that lists a mod wins.
settings.dev_build_hint: For people who build castanea from source: run a checkout or build folder in place instead of the newest release.
settings.dev_build_set: In use: {folder}. Updates are off while it is set.
settings.release_url_hint: Where the game builds come from. Only https:// (or a server on this computer). Empty uses the default.
settings.beta_hint: Try new game versions early. They may be less stable. Off: stable builds only.
launcher.line_restart: castanea launcher {version} · restart to update to {new}
launcher.line_off: castanea launcher {version} · automatic updates are off
launcher.line_failed: castanea launcher {version} · could not check for updates
launcher.line_refused: castanea launcher {version} · update {new} refused, not signed by castanea
launcher.restart_game_running: The game is running. Close it, then restart the launcher.
launcher.why_appimage: This launcher runs as an AppImage, which cannot replace itself. Download the new AppImage.
launcher.why_system: A package manager or the system owns this launcher's folder. Update it the way you installed it.
launcher.why_readonly: This launcher's folder is read-only for you, so it cannot replace itself. Download the new version.
launcher.ready_note: castanea launcher {version} is ready. Restart to use it.
launcher.refused_note: The launcher update {version} was refused: this download is not signed by castanea. The installed launcher stays.
launcher.refused_text: The new launcher was not signed by castanea and was thrown away. The installed launcher stays.
launcher.skipped: Skipped because it did not start: {versions}
notes.update_unsigned: The update was refused: this download is not signed by castanea. The installed game stays.
settings.launcher_update_hint: Downloads a newer launcher in the background and offers a restart. Off in offline mode.
settings.allow_unsigned_hint: Developer use only: installs game builds with a missing or wrong signature. Only debug builds of the launcher honour it; release builds ignore it. It never applies to the launcher's own updates.
about.text: Keeps castanea at its newest release, starts it, and manages and finds mods.
about.license: MIT licence. Built with egui. Text in Inter (SIL Open Font License 1.1), icons from Phosphor (MIT), titles in the project's own copper font.
about.key_pages: Open the pages in sidebar order
about.key_escape: Close a question, leave mod details
about.security_text: Downloads use HTTPS only and are checked against a SHA-256 from the release or the index; a build that fails the check is thrown away and the installed one stays. The launcher runs no downloaded code except the game. New mods start disabled; before enabling one you see what it declares.
notes.no_graphics: The game was not started: no graphics backend works here. {error}. Update the graphics driver, or pick one in Settings → Advanced → Graphics.
notes.vulkan_died: The game stopped right after starting with Vulkan. The launcher will use wgpu for this game version from now on.
backend.reason_vulkan_works: Vulkan passed the check before the start
backend.reason_vulkan_failed: Vulkan did not pass the check, wgpu is used
backend.reason_vulkan_crashed: Vulkan stopped right after starting before, wgpu is used
backend.reason_no_probe: this game version has no graphics check, the game chooses
backend.reason_environment: CASTANEA_BACKEND is set in the extra environment
